"""Auto-generated by Agent 3's tests_gen.py (design_agent3.md Section 6). Do not edit by hand: regenerated from the plan item's test_contract and symbol_map every run."""

import ast
import importlib
import importlib.util
import inspect
from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def _unit_source_dir(unit_slug):
    spec = importlib.util.find_spec("app.units." + unit_slug)
    if spec is None or not spec.submodule_search_locations:
        pytest.fail("app.units." + unit_slug + " package not found")
    return Path(next(iter(spec.submodule_search_locations)))


def _unit_py_files(unit_slug):
    return sorted(_unit_source_dir(unit_slug).rglob("*.py"))


def _unit_source_text(unit_slug):
    return "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in _unit_py_files(unit_slug))


def _unit_top_level_names(unit_slug):
    names = set()
    for path in _unit_py_files(unit_slug):
        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
        for node in ast.iter_child_nodes(tree):
            if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
                names.add(node.name)
    return names


def _wp_compat_bindings(unit_slug):
    """Names in a unit's own source that resolve to app.wp_compat: the
    module's own bound alias (import app.wp_compat [as x] / from app import
    wp_compat [as x]), and flat function names (from app.wp_compat import
    get_option, ...)."""
    module_aliases = set()
    flat_names = set()
    for path in _unit_py_files(unit_slug):
        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
                for alias in node.names:
                    if alias.name in ("app.wp_compat", "wp_compat"):
                        module_aliases.add(alias.asname or alias.name.rpartition(".")[2])
            elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
                if node.module == "app":
                    for alias in node.names:
                        if alias.name == "wp_compat":
                            module_aliases.add(alias.asname or alias.name)
                elif node.module == "app.wp_compat":
                    for alias in node.names:
                        flat_names.add(alias.asname or alias.name)
    return module_aliases, flat_names


def _bare_calls(unit_slug, name):
    """Call nodes across the unit's own files whose callee is the bare Name
    `name` — used to catch a call that bypasses app.wp_compat entirely."""
    calls = []
    for path in _unit_py_files(unit_slug):
        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == name:
                calls.append(path)
    return calls

@pytest.mark.contract
def test_outgoing_dependency_aa39ff11_78b7_4ba4_973c_ec5bac27ffb6_78035188():
    forbidden = ['tax_rate']
    shadowed = sorted(set(_unit_top_level_names('01_01_billing')) & set(forbidden))
    assert not shadowed, 're-implements %r instead of importing them from the dependency' % (shadowed,)
    source = _unit_source_text('01_01_billing')
    expected_modules = ['app.units.01_02_tax.module']
    assert any(m in source for m in expected_modules), 'dependency module never referenced: %r' % (expected_modules,)


@pytest.mark.contract
def test_external_call_number_format_5dd136c5():
    assert 'number_format' not in _unit_top_level_names('01_01_billing'), 'number_format is reimplemented instead of routed through app.wp_compat'
    _, flat_names = _wp_compat_bindings('01_01_billing')
    bare_calls = _bare_calls('01_01_billing', 'number_format')
    if bare_calls:
        assert 'number_format' in flat_names, 'number_format is called without importing it from app.wp_compat'
